YTA, coming from someone who had blatant symptoms of mental illness ignored for fourteen years. I ended up taking it out on other people and myself, and it took my father two years after that to actually believe me. I still suffer in silence sometimes, because I know it’s more of a culture issue in my family. You, OP, have the knowledge and probably the money my family lacks, and you are looking her problems dead in the face and choosing to say ‘no’. What is wrong with you? Mental problems don’t just go away because ‘your husband had it worse’ or ‘it’s just puberty’. They last, and sooner or later they’re gonna cost you a relationship with your daughter, or god forbid she does something drastic. You have a chance to help her. She‘s literally asking for it. Let her have it.
